mentions.name: Million-Lock Door Puzzle Game
mentions.description: A real-time multiplayer puzzle game centered on a door with one million locks; some locks open with combos, while others can only be opened by more than two players. Built to practice with PostgreSQL and currently at an HTML prototype stage.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm also writing a puzzle game with a door that has one million locks. It's real-time multiplayer; some locks have opening combos, and others can be opened only by > 2 players. I'm writing it to practice with PostgreSQL. I only have an HTML prototype to test it. https://6251.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/hn-door-screenshot.png.
